AEDUCANS_HAMMER_GEAR_DESC: The legacy of Paragon Aeducan, passed down through the generations.
ALAMARRI_WARSTAFF_GEAR_DESC: Its deft weight and design make this weapon excellent at parrying, as well as landing killing blows.
ALCHEMICAL_CONCOCTION_GEAR_DESC: The primary ingredient in this mysterious elixir is derived from the blood of Grey Wardens and the darkspawn taint within it, hence its scarcity.
ANTIQUE_WARDEN_CROSSBOW_GEAR_DESC: Despite its age, this crossbow is in excellent condition. It is easy to see that the Warden Master Scout who previously owned this took especially good care of it.
APPRENTICE_COAT_GEAR_DESC: Sturdier than robes, apprentices training for battle may find this coat to provide better protection.
ARDENT_BLOSSOM_GEAR_DESC: What you lose in defense, you gain in the sundering power of the lyrium infused in this herbal helmet.
ARLATHAN_FOCUSING_CRYSTAL_GEAR_DESC: Golden amber empowers the mind to focus, through an ancient technique known only to the Elves of Arlathan.
ARMADA_CAPTAINS_KNIFE_GEAR_DESC: Left over from the Raiders of the Waking Sea, this blade still smells of salt and viscera.
ARMOR_OF_THE_RIVER_DANE_GEAR_DESC: Victoriously stripped in the Battle of River Dane from an Orlesian commander as a prize.
ARMS_OF_THE_CHAMPION_GEAR_DESC: Signature piece of the Mantle of the Champion. Only those with great cunning can truly put the mantle to use.
ASAARASH_CHANFRON_GEAR_DESC: By protecting the face, a mount can maintain focus in the midst of battle.
ASAARASH_CRINIERE_GEAR_DESC: Complements the peytral and chanfron by protecting the animal's neck.
ASAARASH_FLANCHARD_GEAR_DESC: Provides extra protection for the animal's flanks.
ASAARASH_PEYTRAL_GEAR_DESC: Designed to protect the chest of the horse, this peytral significantly bolsters the animal’s protection while charging.
ASAARASH_SADDLE_GEAR_DESC: Functional, if not stylish, this saddle is designed for riding into long battles.
ASSASSINS_RECURVE_GEAR_DESC: Designed to the specifications of the Grand Duchess Florianne de Chalons.

BLOODLINE_GEAR_DESC: Left to his daughter, Bethany, Malcolm Hawke knew his blood carried the gifts of the Fade.
BOOK_OF_THE_LADY_GEAR_DESC: A text found at a sacred Avvar altar, bound in protection of the holy ground.
BOOTS_OF_FAITH_GEAR_DESC: Sturdy boots, a testimony of faith in Andraste and the Maker for protection.
BOW_OF_CLEANSING_FIRE_GEAR_DESC: Equipped with flaming arrows to burn through the most stalwart of defenses.
BOW_OF_THE_BERESAAD_GEAR_DESC: With strength inspired by belief in the Qun, arrows fired from this bow can rip through armor.
BOW_OF_THE_RIGHTEOUS_GEAR_DESC: With righteousness shall the unworthy be smote.
BROKEN_GRIFFON_HELM_GEAR_DESC: This helm is but a relic of times past, when the Grey Wardens commanded mighty griffons.
BRUTE_HAMMER_GEAR_DESC: Built to crush bone with ease.
BULLS_EDGE_GEAR_DESC: The heft and balance of this greataxe makes it a favored weapon of Iron Bull.
CAPTAINS_PLATE_GEAR_DESC: Plate armor awarded to those who reach the rank of Guard Captain.
CERTAINTY_GEAR_DESC: A sword of deepest corruption and conviction.
CHANTRY_ROBE_GEAR_DESC: This robe fills Chantry initiates with the vitality of the Maker.
CHANTRY_SHIELD_GEAR_DESC: This shield bears the symbol of the Chantry, as an inspiration of faith.
CHESTPLATE_OF_THE_FORTRESS_GEAR_DESC: The warrior Hawke liberated this chestplate from the lifeless body of Corypheus. A trophy worth bragging about, to say the least
CHEVALIERS_CUTLASS_GEAR_DESC: The favored sword of the Orlesian Chevaliers.
CIRCLE_MAGE_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: A staff imbued with magic, wielded by those skilled in the art.
COBRA_CROWN_GEAR_DESC: This ancient crown is instilled with the power of Archons from times past.
COLES_HAT_GEAR_DESC: Beneath the brim of this hat, you’re unlikely to look Cole in the eyes before he severs your jugular.
COURTIER_FAN_GEAR_DESC: Mastered by the greatest players of the Grand Game, the language of fans ranges from inviting to vengeful.
CROW_DAGGER_GEAR_DESC: An Antivan blade, crafted by the legendary Crow assassins. Maybe.
CROW_SHIELD_GEAR_DESC: Light wooden buckler adorned with the symbol of the Antivan Crows, elite assassins of Thedas.
CUIRASS_OF_THE_WINDS_GEAR_DESC: As beautiful and cruel as a storm, crafted by a Rivaini seer.
CURSEPOWERALL_NOATTACK: Targets all enemies and curses Power (does not attack).
DALISH_RING_GEAR_DESC: Traditional ring of the Dalish, symbolizing their bond in life and death.
DALISH_ROBES_GEAR_DESC: It’s hard not to admire the fine quality of these Robes. Painstaking effort was put into each and every fiber of this.
DALISH_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: These staves can be seen frequently among the Dalish. It’s surprisingly tough, most likely paying homage to its peoples’ promise.

DUSTER_BATTLEAXE_GEAR_DESC: Home to recycled swords, maces and... is that part of a broom?
DUSTER_GREAVES_GEAR_DESC: Woven together by what you hope was actual leather. These greaves smell particularly moldy.
DUSTER_LEATHER_ARMOR_GEAR_DESC: Woven together by what you hope was actual leather. Is that part of a shoe etched into it?

REMARKABLE_EMERALD_GEAR_DESC: A particularly well-cut gem of a beautiful green hue. Makes for a great gift or a lustrous reinforcement.
RETRIBUTION_ELIXIR_GEAR_DESC: Dangerous elixir only to be taken when the tides of battle turn too far out of favor.
REVERED_DEFENDER_MAUL_GEAR_DESC: Giant maul of the Sha-Brytol Defender. Notched to both crush and tear.
RING_OF_DOUBT_GEAR_DESC: Forced into an arranged marriage, a young magister enchanted his wedding ring with invisibility.
RING_OF_RESILIENCE_GEAR_AURA_LOC_OVERRID: <color=green>+5% stun, slow, and power drain resist for allies.</color>
RING_OF_RESILIENCE_GEAR_DESC: As the beating of the wearer's heart increases, so does the ring's mysterious glow.
RITUAL_BREAKER_GEAR_DESC: This ornate mace is almost as beautiful as the sound of the bones it so easily shatters with each blow.
ROBES_OF_THE_ARCHITECT_GEAR_DESC: Unlike other darkspawn who favor savage, cruel armor, the Architect's robes appear almost civilized.
RUBY_RING_GEAR_DESC: Famously worn by Empress Celene, this ring enchants any weapon with flames.
RUNE_PRESTIGE_REJECT_LOCKED_MESSAGE: Unlock the prestige rune slot using gems in order to use this rune.
RUNE_PRESTIGE_REJECT_RUNE_MESSAGE: Only prestige runes may be applied to this slot. To see what runes are available, tap on the rune slot.
RUNE_PRESTIGE_REJECT_SLOT_MESSAGE: This rune can only be activated on the prestige rune slot.
RUNES_CTA_TEXT: Drag runes into the targets to assign
SAAREBAS_RESTRAINTS_GEAR_DESC: Strong bonds, protecting the Saarebas from themselves and others.
SACRIFICIAL_DAGGER_GEAR_DESC: Weapons made of volcanic aurum pierce like no others. The spirit damage of this dagger makes things worse.
SAD_WEAPON_GEAR_DESC: AKA Mark’s Mangled Mace. The power in this weaponry comes more from the humiliation of taking a banana across the face.
SAVAGE_THORN_GEAR_DESC: This crude blade rips into an enemy and makes its presence felt.
SCOUT_ARMOR_GEAR_DESC: Sleek, agile, homicidal. Just like Sera.
SCOUT_COAT_ARMS_GEAR_DESC: An upgrade to the armor worn by scouts on patrol.
SCOUT_HAT_GEAR_DESC: Hardened leather helm light enough for quick movement in the field.
SCOUT_QUIVER_GEAR_DESC: Ever wonder why it's called a quiver? Maybe it inspires fear.
SEER_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: This staff's energy is fueled by the pain of allies.
SENIOR_WARDENS_STAFF_GEAR_AURA_LOC_OVERR: <color=green>+6% Power for white and black faction (stacking). Janeka equip: +5% Health.</color>
SENIOR_WARDENS_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: Those who’ve climbed the Warden ranks may just have the grip to contain all the devilry this staff can muster.
SENTINEL_GAUNTLETS_GEAR_DESC: The gauntlets from the Sentinel Elves’ distinctive armor.
SENTINEL_GREAVES_GEAR_DESC: The greaves from the Sentinel Elves’ distinctive armor.
SENTINEL_PLATE_PAULDRON_GEAR_DESC: The pauldron from the Sentinel Elves' distinctive armor.
SENTINEL_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: This crystaline staff grants its wielder enhanced perception of the living world and the Fade alike.
SER_ALVARDS_SWORD_GEAR_DESC: Forgotten in the Blackmarsh for decades, there is a distinct odor to this blade, and not a pleasant one.
SERAS_RAISIN_COOKIES_GEAR_DESC: Sera does not like raisin cookies. The flavor of these drive her to violence against those who do.
SERUM_OF_AMBITION_GEAR_DESC: A volatile concoction meant to enhance the abilities of those with weak bodies but steeled convictions.
SHIELD_OF_LE_MARQUE_GEAR_DESC: The crest of House Le Marque, the lineage of the refugee leader Fairbanks. To the sun on blessed wings.
SIDEREAL_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: The staff of Aurelian Titus, a magister of the Tevinter Imperium. Blood magic seeps from its every fiber.
SKYWATCHERS_CLEAVER_GEAR_DESC: Ceremonial greatsword of the Skywatcher - removes a limb with ease.
SLOW_ALL_DRAIN25_ALLIES_CRIT7_NO_ATTACK: Slows all enemies, drains small Power, and allies gain 7% 2X Damage chance (does not attack).
SLOWS_ALL_CURSE_POWER_BACKROW_STUN_COLUM: Slows all enemies and targets the back row and curses Power, then has a very high chance to stun a column (does not attack).
SLOWS_ROW_HEAVY_POWERGAIN_ALLIES_50: Heavily slows a row, more likely the back row, and allies gain 50% power (does not attack).
SMUGGLERS_DAGGER_GEAR_DESC: Easily hidden and quickly wielded, a favorite blade of the less-favored.
SOLDIERS_PLATE_GEAR_DESC: Inexpensive but dependable, this tried and true breastplate will serve you well.
SOOTHERS_SAPPHIRE_GEAR_DESC: This enchanting gem glows with a soothing energy, granting peace to those who seek it.
SOULWRECKER_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: Brimming with a fierce energy, this staff begins to crackle the moment it is held.
SPEAR_THROWER_GEAR_AURA_LOC_OVERRIDE: <color=green>+5% bonus damage vs non-Spirits. +3% 2X Damage chance.</color>
SPEAR_THROWER_GEAR_DESC: This grisly bow can penetrate all but the thickest armor with the fortitude of sylvanwood.
SPECTRAL_SCALE_GEAR_DESC: Taken from the hide of a defeated spectral dragon. It feels ethereal, almost as if it's not there.
SPIRIT_MAUL_GEAR_DESC: The enchantment of the Crossroads infused in this maul binds its bearer to the Dread Wolf.
SQUAD_CTA: Drag heroes in/out of targets to assign ({0}/{1})
STAFF_OF_AIDAHN_ALLIED_GEAR_DESC: Crafted from raw red lyrium, this staff leeches life from everyone around it.
STAFF_OF_CORRUPTION_GEAR_DESC: If they call us corrupt, let us be corruption.
STAFF_OF_FAITH_GEAR_DESC: By faith, protected. With faith, ascended. Through faith, strengthened.
STAFF_OF_SHADOWS_GEAR_DESC: A dark staff, with a human skull carved into it.
STONEHAMMER_PLATE_GEAR_DESC: Commissioned by King Endrin Stonehammer, this armor was enchanted and gifted to the victor of the Grand Proving.
STROUDS_TARGE_GEAR_DESC: Reinforced shield of the Grey Warden Ser Stroud. Enhances the luster of a glorious stache.
STUDDED_LEATHER_PAULDRON_GEAR_DESC: Fortified leather provides sturdy protection while granting full mobility to its wearer.
STUFFED_MABARI_GEAR_DESC: You won’t find a more devoted companion!
STUN_SINGLE_DRAIN_ALL25_CRITGAIN10_ALLIE: Stuns a single enemy, drains 25% power from all enemies, and allies gain 10% crit chance (does not attack).
SUPER_WISP_ATTACK_ABILITY_KEY: Provides an <color=green>extra</color> strong boost when consumed.
SWIFTRUNNERS_SHIELD_GEAR_DESC: There was heraldry on this shield once, but it has long since faded.
SWORD_OF_CHARRIS_ALLIED_GEAR_DESC: Crafted from raw red lyrium, this sword leeches life from everyone around it.
TALON_OF_THE_SKIES_GEAR_DESC: Blessed by the Lady of the Skies, this blade gives enemies pause before ripping into them.
TEMPLAR_BREASTPLATE_GEAR_DESC: Standard-issue armor worn by the Templar order.
TEMPLAR_COMMANDER_PAULDRON_GEAR_DESC: Cascaded steel. Built to carry the party's load.
TEMPLAR_HELMET_GEAR_DESC: Standard-issue helmet worn by the Templar order.
TEMPLAR_LONGSWORD_GEAR_DESC: Well-crafted, standard-issue longsword of the Templar Order.
TEMPLAR_SHIELD_GEAR_DESC: Standard-issue shield for Knights of the Templar order.
THE_ANCESTORS_GREAVES_GEAR_DESC: Relic of an ancient set of armor and a time when war thrived on brilliant strategy.
THE_BIND_THAT_GUIDES_GEAR_DESC: No matter how loosely this belt is tied, after a few steps, it wraps itself snugly around the waist.
THE_BLACK_FOXS_JERKIN_GEAR_DESC: The final tale of the Black Fox recounts the loss of this jerkin while searching for the city of the elves of Arlathan.
THE_DIVINE_ARMOR_GEAR_DESC: This radiant armor was crafted to serve the leader of the Chantry.
THE_ELDERS_GRIMOIRE_GEAR_DESC: Accursed grimoire of the Elder One containing the secrets of red lyrium and other demonic rites.
THE_EYE_THAT_WEEPS_GEAR_DESC: Condensation slowly forms on the gem's outer surface, no matter how many times it's wiped clean.
THE_GOLDEN_PRINCES_HELM_GEAR_DESC: Young Empress Celene was captivated by the Golden Prince’s stories, his helm the only crown he’d wear.
THE_GOLDEN_PRINCES_PAULDRON_GEAR_DESC: Companion pauldron to the Golden Prince's Raiment. The Lion of Orlais shoulders the brunt of attack.
THE_GOLDEN_PRINCES_RAIMENT_GEAR_DESC: Ornate armor of the Golden Prince, Emile Deveraux, who captured the hearts of the Orlesian commoners.
THE_HAND_THAT_CUTS_GEAR_DESC: This ring grows unusually warm when slipped onto a finger, pulsing in time with the wearer’s heartbeat.
THE_LADYS_WRATH_GEAR_DESC: Blessed by the Lady of the Skies, each swing of this maul empowers its wielder.
THE_SKIN_THAT_STALKS_GEAR_DESC: The leather of this armor gives off a faint, living heat. It is heavier than it looks.
TOME_OF_ARCANE_TECHNIQUE_GEAR_DESC: Researched by the Imperial Chantry, this tome provides insights into the Fade.
TOME_OF_KOSLUN_GEAR_DESC: A sacred scripture of Qunari lore, written by Ashkaari Koslun, founder of the Qun.
TOME_OF_PHYSICAL_TECHNIQUE_GEAR_DESC: Scribed by a master, this manuscript is rarely seen outside the most prestigious organizations.
TOME_OF_RIFTS_GEAR_DESC: This text teaches its acolytes how to draw energy from, and move within, the Fade.
TOME_OF_SKILL_AND_SUNDRY_GEAR_DESC: A sprawling work of early Ferelden that attempts to unify many disciplines under one theory of mental capacity.
TOME_OF_THE_MORTAL_VESSEL_GEAR_DESC: Fear of blood magic stigmatized academic dissection, but anatomical works have been saved.
UNIT_DRAGONOFTHEELDERONEI: Dragon of the Elder One I
UNIT_DRAGONOFTHEELDERONEII: Dragon of the Elder One II
UNIT_DRAGONOFTHEELDERONEIII: Dragon of the Elder One III
UNIT_DRAGONOFTHEELDERONEIV: Dragon of the Elder One IV
UNIT_QUEENOFTHEEASTERNSEASI: Queen of the Eastern Seas I
UNIT_QUEENOFTHEEASTERNSEASII: Queen of the Eastern Seas II
UNIT_QUEENOFTHEEASTERNSEASIII: Queen of the Eastern Seas III
UNIT_QUEENOFTHEEASTERNSEASIV: Queen of the Eastern Seas IV
VENATORI_BOW_GEAR_DESC: This bow is imbued with a virulent bomb spell, causing its arrows to inflict explosive damage.
VENATORI_GREAVES_GEAR_DESC: Issued to Venatori soldiers, these greaves are interwoven with the former chains of slaves.
VENATORI_HELMET_GEAR_AURA_LOC_OVERRIDE: <color=green>+3% Health and stun resist for Venatori.</color>
VENATORI_HELMET_GEAR_DESC: Enclosed helmet of the Venatori soldier.
VENATORI_STAFF_BLADE_GEAR_DESC: Inspired by zealous beliefs, the Venatori use this weapon to sow chaos in enemies.
VENATORI_TOWER_SHIELD_GEAR_DESC: Imbued with protective spells, this shield fully covers its wielder in defense.
VESTMENTS_OF_THE_ARCHMAGE_GEAR_DESC: Worn by mages who have attained the title of Archmage, one of the highest and most powerful ranks of the Circle.
VESTMENTS_OF_THE_DRAGON_HUNTER_GEAR_DESC: Found next to Revenant Gurd’s lifeless body, this light armor is reserved for only the most fearsome of Dragonslayers.
VIAL_OF_DRAGONS_BLOOD_GEAR_DESC: While dragon’s blood has an ample number of uses, most seek it for its magical properties. Drinking it can confer great power to the drinker, if they survive it.
VIGILANCE_GEAR_DESC: Once in a dozen generations, a truly legendary weapon is forged. This blade, created from the bones of an ancient dragon, sings with power.
VINSOMER_SCALE_GEAR_DESC: Taken from the hide of a slain Vinsomer, buzzing with electricity.
VIRTUOSITY_GEAR_DESC: The magical effects of this lute are readily apparent to any who hold it, but there is only one person who can make use of its full potential.
VITAAR_OF_THE_DRAGON_HUNTER_GEAR_DESC: This face paint is actually created from a deadly poison. However, the unique physiology of the Qunari neutralizes its effect and bolsters their strength.
VORACITY_GEAR_DESC: This staff whispers to its wielder, calling out for ever more blood to sate its cravings.
WALKING_DEATH_GEAR_AURA_LOC_OVERRIDE: <color=green>+10% bonus damage vs red faction, black faction, and Defenders (stacking).</color>
WALKING_DEATH_GEAR_DESC: The marks of the Mortalitasi are unmistakeable. How this dagger came to be in Emprise du Lion is unknown, but the sting of its blade is not.
WARDEN_HELMET_GEAR_DESC: Winged helm of the Grey Wardens.
WARDEN_TOWER_SHIELD_GEAR_DESC: Heavy shield of the Warden-Commander. The insignia of the Grey Wardens deflects the fiercest of attacks.
WARM_ORB_GEAR_DESC: Though harmless at first glance, this trinket hums with power and answers only to blood.
WEDGE_OF_DESTINY_GEAR_AURA_LOC_OVERRIDE: <color=green>Convert 4% of damage taken into Health. Resists the first 300 damage per hit, since there’s a lot of cheese to get through.</color>
WEDGE_OF_DESTINY_GEAR_DESC: This unholy marriage of dragon scales and sharp cheddar is more effective than it would seem. Weak to fire, unless you want fondue.
WILHELMS_STAFF_GEAR_DESC: Once the weapon of the hero of the Fereldan Rebellion. Despite its age, its potency is undiminished.
WINTERWEIGHT_GEAR_DESC: Found within the Deep Roads, guarded by a dragon, and infused with magical powers for defense.
WISP_ATTACK_ABILITY_KEY: Provides a strong boost when consumed.
YAVANALIS_GEAR_DESC: Staff of "the Pale Demon", a Dalish Keeper known for his vicious attacks on Orlesians.
